description: This file defines the OrderService interface, which declares methods related to order management in an e-commerce system. It includes methods for calculating totals, generating invoices, processing orders, and retrieving order data.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for order-related operations within the sales management system.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a status history record to a given order.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the final total of an order based on the provided order summary, customer, store, and language contexts. There are two overloaded versions, one including the customer.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price of items in a shopping cart, considering customer, store, and language contexts.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Generates a PDF or similar invoice stream for a specific order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all orders associated with a particular merchant store, optionally filtered by criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new order or updates an existing order.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order, including customer, items, summary, payment, and optionally transaction details.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if a given order has associated downloadable files.
